pages.text: The M10 bestiary contains more than 1,800 entries. Kills, contracts, and encounters can unlock records; undiscovered entries appear locked in the bestiary screen.
pages.title: Demon Beast Bestiary

pages.text: Threat and tier data come from beast_thirteen_tier_map and BeastTierService. Higher tiers have better drops and stricter contract requirements.
pages.title: Thirteen Tiers

pages.text: True Spirits and companion_only creatures never enter ordinary spawn pools. Contracts also enforce beast-tier and player-realm requirements.
pages.title: True Spirits and Restrictions

pages.text: Use /seeking_immortals lore bestiary or bind the bestiary key. This screen is read-only and never changes gameplay state.
pages.title: Opening the Bestiary
